crop.notes: Whole 'Boxiana' article is present; the bottom of the clipping also includes an unrelated 'Meeting of Irish Citizens' item.

ocr.notes: Most of the text is readable but several lines are garbled (description of the crowd, Heenan's appearance, Looney's bet).

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that Jem Mace and John C. Heenan sparred before a packed house at the Varieties theater, and that Allen's St. Louis friends, having seen Mace, still backed Allen to win their May fight.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The Missouri Republican -- St. Louis, March 23, 1870'; the St. Louis Republic name dates from 1888.

facts.fact: Allen's fight with Jem Mace was booked for May 1870
Jem Mace and John C. Heenan gave a sparring exhibition at the Varieties theater in St. Louis, then left for Cincinnati, where Mace was to begin training for the Allen fight
